description: This file defines a function to decorate a command object with various CLI options for a Playwright-based server, including server configuration, browser options, and extension handling. It also includes logic to start different server modes and check for ffmpeg installation.

methods.name: decorateCommand
methods.description: Adds CLI options to a command object for configuring a Playwright server, and sets up server start logic based on options.

methods.name: checkFfmpeg
methods.description: Checks if ffmpeg is installed and accessible.
